create_dataset_instance: create a ScanNetpp_Multiview dataset instance with 4 views, window size 60, and a specified ROOT path
load_metadata: load scene metadata, intrinsics, and trajectories from an all_metadata.npz file into the dataset
generate_view_combinations: generate random combinations of image indices within temporal windows for multiview training samples
get_multiview_sample: get a multiview sample with RGB images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given index
visualize_pointcloud: visualize 3D point clouds and camera poses from multiview samples using SceneViz in a notebook
